heuristics.name: tested-vocab
heuristics.description: Pick the rarest Latinate/classic test-prep word that still fits many sentence frames, over concrete/technical words (nautical, malarial).

heuristics.name: odd-one-out
heuristics.description: Pick the option whose meaning or polarity differs from the other three.

heuristics.name: pair-logic
heuristics.description: Two-blank items: pick the pair whose words are most internally coherent as a cause/effect or matched-tone pair.

heuristics.name: shared-word
heuristics.description: Two-blank items where two options share a first word: assume key is one of those; choose the contrastive second word.

heuristics.name: antonym-pair
heuristics.description: When two options are near-antonyms, assume the key is one of them; pick the one fitting a more common frame.

notes: No item had a reject that could be ruled out without the sentence, so reject_certain is false throughout. Most picks are arbitrary; signal heuristics are weak priors.
